checks.reason: The printed H2 orientation puts A=Z1 union Z3 on H2- while P1 requires H2+, excluding intended finite inputs. The five moment-curve points satisfy spatial general position by Vandermonde and the displayed strict sign table. Independently challenging the report repair shows orientation reversal alone leaves both closed polyhedra meeting along y=9/4,z=9x/4; (0,9/4,0) and the middle point determine a line meeting all three sets. This matters for the chain/antichain and cap argument.
checks.counterevidence: This is a failed construction and incomplete earlier repair, not a counterexample to the existence proposition or qualitative theorem.
checks.repair_check: Root replaced the report paragraph with an explicit positive-margin construction: C,A,B have affine sign triples (+,-,+),(-,+,+),(-,-,-); finite strict separation allows eta>0, and Q1/Q2 use h0<=-eta with opposite h1,h2 margins. Each of the three sets is strictly separated from the hull of the other two. A common transversal line would have a middle intersection point, a contradiction. Three half-spaces remain, so nine-facet/21-edge box truncation remains valid. h=(f0,f1,-f2),eta=1/4 verifies the concrete witness.

checks.counterevidence: m tends to infinity under the fixed Ramsey inversions, with m<=O(n^(1/4)); (1/m+1/n)log(e(m+1)) tends to zero. Thus the corrected bounded-loss estimate preserves the qualitative 2^{o(n)} mechanism.
